configure_clang_substitutions: configure the test suite to invoke clang with environment variables and tool substitutions
configure_lld_substitutions: configure the test suite to invoke lld with environment variables and tool substitutions
add_tool_substitutions: add tool substitutions to the config for specified tool patterns and search directories
use_default_substitutions: set up default substitutions including python, FileCheck, count, and not tools
configure_llvm_test_features: configure lit test features including sanitizers, platform, and target triple detection
